evidence.title: Instatic — own your site, love building it

name: Instatic
summary: Self-hosted open-source CMS and visual website builder that publishes plain static HTML from a single Bun server.
description: A visual canvas editor, content engine, media manager, plugin sandbox and publisher in one self-hosted app, backed by SQLite or Postgres. Pressing publish writes static HTML files; a built-in AI agent and an MCP server endpoint can edit the site, and plugins run sandboxed in QuickJS-WASM.
contains: One Bun server holds the editor, content engine, auth, forms, plugins and publisher
publishing bakes static HTML files swapped in atomically; MIT licensed
storage in SQLite or Postgres, switched by one environment variable
built-in AI agent with 35 site-building tools and 15 content tools, bring your own model
MCP server (Streamable HTTP) so Claude Code, Cursor or Codex can drive the CMS
plugins run in QuickJS-WASM workers without filesystem or network by default
Super Import turns an existing static site into pages, classes and design tokens
8.9k GitHub stars; deploy via Railway, Docker or the repo
